prompts.kit:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production TRANSPARENT sprite atlas of SIX SEPARATE handcrafted paper-theatre parts for Pokémon Emerald SKY PILLAR SUMMIT, Rayquaza's ancient ruined tower high above the ocean. 1536x1024 landscape, precise 3 columns by 2 rows, generous transparent gutters of 35px around every independent piece. No characters or Rayquaza, no complete room, no Pokeball, no words. Strong cut-paper style like a luxury Paper Mario popup book: thin overlapping irregular colored cardstock sheets, tangible fibrous matte surface, shallow contact shadows, clean hand-cut contours. NOT voxel, NOT thick low-poly 3D sculpture, NOT a polished 3D render. Orthographic front view of each part.
TOP LEFT: simple pale cerulean arched sky backing sheet, delicate cloudy paper texture, no architecture or clouds pasted on it.
TOP MIDDLE: asymmetrical weathered warm-gray and pale sage ancient BROKEN STONE PILLARS cluster, one tall jagged pillar and a shorter broken lintel with clearly separate thin overlapping stone-paper layers, worn gold-green geometric rune fragments. Irregular broken silhouette and transparent open sky holes; no complete symmetrical temple arch.
TOP RIGHT: isolated ruined section of the Sky Pillar: two uneven slender crumbling columns, exposed stacked stone slabs and a short broken staircase partly hidden by one small cloud at the base. Sparse yellow-green moss cutouts; no castle spire or roof, no ship.
BOTTOM LEFT: a LONG LOW elegant cloud-bank strip of many overlapping ivory and pale-blue thin paper scallops, asymmetrical windswept wisps, transparent gaps between outer curls, no stones or sky backdrop.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: one LOW BROAD squat ancient weathered stone trainer platform, clear flat top, pale sage slabs and small emerald-green angular ancient rune on front, original stone structure not ornamental furniture; isolated silhouette.
BOTTOM RIGHT: low cluster of separate flat stone fragments, sparse windblown grass and ivory cloud wisps, suitable foreground cutout, no large cliff or floor behind.
Each object must fit completely inside its own cell. Rich meticulous craft detail, layered paper edges instead of volumetric bevels. Light comes from upper left. Muted ancient stone contrasts with beautiful blue sky and soft cream clouds.
prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. A single square, perfectly TOP DOWN, seamless-to-edge floor artwork for a handcrafted cut-paper popup of Pokémon Emerald's SKY PILLAR SUMMIT. Entire 1536x1536 canvas must be opaque floor, filled right to all four edges. Weathered warm ivory and pale sage gray ancient stone roof tiles represented by thin overlapping torn cardstock slabs, visible matte paper fibers, tiny offset cut edges, understated contact shadows. A broad very clear OPEN central fighting area: a large shallow concentric ancient engraved stone circle with restrained emerald and ochre geometric rune markings along the outer circle. No text, no modern Pokeball icon. Few thin hairline cracks, tiny scattered stone chips. At the four outer corners only: a little dry pale moss and small carved weathered corner stones, flat top down, no upright props. All texture is truly flat roof paving, NOT 3D modeled chunks, NO perspective, no raised pillars, no clouds painted on the floor, no openings or black holes. Warm limestone and muted sage tones, minimal greenery, subtle ancient sky shrine mood. A beautiful tactile Paper Mario-style paper collage that will be mapped onto a circular stage. Clear fighting silhouettes will stand in the middle; keep most central tiles quiet and light. Lighting soft from upper left.
